rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone who consistently works hard and diligently.

example.english: They are always diligent at work.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 je5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 kan4 lik6

rows.note: Use this when the diligence specifically concerns studying or academic work.

example.english: They are diligent in studying for the exams every day.
example.traditional: 佢為咗考試日日都用功。
example.jyutping: keoi5 wai6 zo2 haau2 si3 jat6 jat6 dou1 jung6 gung1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on taking care and applying attention rather than sheer work rate.

example.english: You can't be careless with your homework; you have to be diligent.
example.traditional: 做功課唔可以求其，要用心。
example.jyutping: zou6 gung1 fo3 m4 ho2 ji5 kau4 kei4 jiu3 jung6 sam1
